South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
                              Meeting Agenda
                    Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 9:30 am
    City Hall - Council Chambers - 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe

South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
Brooke Laine, El Dorado County Board of Supervisors- Chair
Cody Bass, City Councilmember- Vice Chair
Keith Roberts, City Councilmember



Public Participation
South Tahoe Transit JPA Board meetings are held in person at the time and location listed on this agenda.
A public agenda packet is available for review at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, on the City’s Website at
www.cityofslt.us, or by contacting the City Clerk's Office, (530) 542-6005 or sblankenship@cityofslt.us
Public Comment provided in person: Every agenda for regular meetings provides an opportunity for members
of the public to directly address the JPA Board on any item on the agenda or in connection with any item which
the South Tahoe Transit JPA Board will consider. The public is given the opportunity to comment before or
during the South Tahoe Transit JPA Board’s consideration of the item [Government Code Section 54954.3(a)].

In Writing: Written comments received by 3 p.m. the day before the meeting will be distributed to South Tahoe
Transit JPA Board prior to the meeting. Written public comment regarding any item on this agenda may be
sent to PublicComment@cityofslt.us. When emailing comments, identify the agenda item number in the subject
line to which your comments relate. Any such comment that is a public record and is emailed to
PublicComment@cityofslt.us or otherwise provided to a majority of the South Tahoe Transit JPA Board before
the meeting will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at the City Clerk's Office
located at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe [Government Code Section 54957.5(b)]. Written
comments will not be read out loud during the meeting.

The meeting facility is accessible to people with disabilities. Every reasonable effort will be made to
accommodate any person needing special assistance to attend this meeting. Contact the City Clerk at (530)
542-6005 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting for assistance [28 CFR 35.102.35.104 ADA Title II and
Brown Act Government Code Sections 54953.2, 54954.1, 54954.2, and 54957.5].

Call to Order/Pledge of Allegiance

Roll Call

Public Communications
This is the public's opportunity to speak on any topic NOT LISTED on this agenda. Comments shall be
limited to four (4) minutes. In accordance with the Brown Act, the South Tahoe Transit JPA cannot
deliberate or vote on any matter raised under public communications, but may briefly respond to
statements made or questions posed. (Government Code Sections 54954.2)

Consent Agenda

1.   South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority Meeting Minutes
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Motion approving the meeting minutes of July 30,
     2026.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Susan Carpenter, Secretary
     07_30_2026_South_Tahoe_Transit_JPA.docx

2.   Fiscal Year 2026/2027 Meeting Calendar
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Resolution adopting the Fiscal Year 2026/2027 JPA
     regular Board meeting calendar.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Hilary Roverud, JPA Executive Director
     01-Staff Report_Calendar
     02-Resolution FY 2026 2027 Meeting Calendar

Unfinished Business

3.   Tahoe Transit Funding Memo Presentation
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Receive presentation and file.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Hilary Roverud, City Manager
     Staff Report_TRPA Transit Study_20261029.docx

New Business

4.   South Tahoe Transit JPA Fiscal Year 2026/2027 Budget
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Resolution approving the Fiscal Year 2026/2027
     Budget (October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027) South Tahoe Transit JPA Budget and
     directing staff to send requests to the City of South Lake Tahoe and El Dorado County to submit
     funding to the JPA.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Hilary Roverud, JPA Executive Director
     01-Staff_Report_Budget
     02-Resolution FY 2026 2027 Transit JPA Budget

Updates and Announcements – South Tahoe Transit JPA Staff

Boardmember Reports and Comments

Adjournment
I, Susan Carpenter, Secretary for the South Tahoe Transit JPA, declare that the foregoing agenda for the
Thursday, October 29, 2026, South Tahoe Transit JPA meeting was posted and available for review on
Monday, October 26, 2026, at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150. The
agenda was also available on the City's website at https://www.cityofslt.us.
Signed October 23, 2026
\\sc\\ Susan Carpenter, Secretary
